label: context.reference
text:
Use the Microsoft Teams Application through world_mcp_microsoft_teams. Project EE policy must admit it, and the task needs its exact interface binding and this artifact binding. Installation and connection do not establish server liveness.

Use the server's catalogs for Teams chats, channels, messages, meetings, members, and collaboration capabilities that the connected server actually declares. Current capabilities are declared in mcp.operation_catalog, mcp.tool_catalog, mcp.resource_catalog, mcp.resource_templates and mcp.prompt_catalog from world_mcp_microsoft_teams.

Invoke a tool with artifact.send to world_mcp_microsoft_teams, label mcp.operation.request, operation microsoft_teams.call_tool, and arguments containing the exact catalog tool name and argument object. Use microsoft_teams.read_resource, microsoft_teams.get_prompt and microsoft_teams.complete with catalog identifiers; use microsoft_teams.status or microsoft_teams.ping to check liveness or negotiated capabilities.

Wait for the returned MCP result, resource, OAuth, event or refusal artifact before reporting an effect. Credentials, OAuth verifiers, tokens and refresh state stay private to the interface; transfer only non-secret handles and status artifacts.
